review_focus: the redundant compact workspace and fullscreen-toggle state are removed rather than hidden behind a second mode
the single workspace fills the viewport while preserving native viewer controls, local persistence behavior, and engine-specific edit capabilities
source or Canvas, SVG, legacy PNG, and prepared-download actions remain reachable from the full-height workspace according to the existing engine capability contract
the close action is a separate accessible top-right overlay and does not reintroduce a top-height or right-side content gutter
the floating host export dock leaves the native bottom status bar clear and remains inside the viewport at a landscape-tablet width narrower than the supplied screenshots
native mode hides unsupported or redundant host controls while legacy mode retains the existing font, layout, project, PNG, and SVG actions
historical acceptance receipts remain immutable and only a successor receipt binds the four newly changed product/test revisions
the publication fixture resolves current hashes through the newest successor without weakening unrelated historical bindings
the exact successor head passes lint, compile, registry validation, and the complete test suite

iterations.finding: Keeping both compact and fullscreen states would preserve duplicate navigation and export chrome even though fullscreen is already the default product path.
iterations.resolution: Removed the compact workspace contract and fullscreen toggle entirely, leaving one full-height workspace plus one explicit close action.

iterations.finding: A first-pass floating export dock could have overlapped the native viewer bottom status bar, so a legacy-only screenshot was insufficient evidence.
iterations.resolution: Placed the dock above the status area and performed an actual native-mode Chromium readback at 1366x1024; the dock ended at y=980, leaving 44 px of bottom clearance while the editor frame still filled 1366x1024.

iterations.finding: The first full validation after the product change failed only because immutable historical UI evidence still bound the predecessor product-UI test hash.
iterations.resolution: Added a new successor acceptance receipt and exact publication-fixture binding, left all parent evidence immutable, and reran the entire repository validation suite successfully on the successor head.

does_not_establish: GitHub CI success on the later self-review commit
